1: expr (counter = 0)
4: func tick()
  4: block
    5: global [counter] 
    6: expr (counter += 1)
    7: expr print("tick", counter)
    8: return counter
11: func main()
  11: block
    12: expr (arr = list[0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
    13: expr (st = list[1, 2, 3, 4])
    14: while (st and (st.pop() > 2))
      14: block
        15: expr print("popped")
    16: if ((tick() + 0) > 5)
      16: block
        17: expr print("big")
    18: expr (total = 0)
    19: expr (total += tick())
    20: expr (n = 0)
    21: while ((n := (n + 1)) < 3)
      21: block
        22: expr print("walrus", n)
    23: expr (q = list[5, 6, 7])

      24: block
        25: expr print("shift", len(q))

    27: expr print(arr[0], len(st), counter, total, n, len(q), x)
